generation_contract: Entire body exactly four ASCII digits separated by one space, then tokenizer native EOS; no whitespace normalization, no special tokens inside the body, no extracted prefix, no constrained decoder, no forced EOS. Greedy evaluation; full-vocabulary temperature-1 sampling during forward-KL training. Cap 16 includes EOS.
teacher_candidate: Pinned cached Qwen3.5-4B, no pretrained task adapter, frozen parameters, complete device operation instructions and six independently generated fixed worked examples per family. Candidate competence is unmeasured until qualification.
demonstration_boundary: Examples come only from the demonstration partition. All six are used without inspecting or filtering by the current target answer. Coincidental answer equality is not target selection.
training_contract: Existing objectives.distillation_loss sdft_forward kernel on fresh learner trajectories, fixed qualified teacher (instruction_demo or one trained teacher), same student initialization and optimizer/task order versus oracle SFT including native EOS. No teacher EMA, feedback or rollout rejection. Persistent learner and optimizer through A,B,C; no replay. Evaluations use learner prompt alone.
heldout_contract: Six disjoint input hash partitions shared across families with independent RNG per split, including separate initial and fallback validation partitions. Train and both validation splits use depth 1-2; composition depth 3-4. No held-out predictions in qualification; test/composition only after both learner arms finish all updates. One internally generated final answer, not external execution. No hyperparameter selection.
failure_action: On instruction_demo rejection, parent may run the single predefined teacher_training stage. Preserve initial failure artifacts. On trained_teacher rejection, stop this protocol. No prompt changes, decoder rescue, altered thresholds or additional teacher runs.
claim_boundary: Bounded synthetic context distillation, one seed. Not a named SDFT/SDPO reproduction, Qwen3-8B static-LoRA consolidation, broad continual learning, or portability evidence.

sources.relation: Reports practical forward KL and EMA teacher; this experiment reuses the full-vocabulary forward-KL kernel but holds the teacher frozen.
Feedback-conditioned self-distillation; this experiment has no feedback mechanism and is not SDPO.

historical_evidence.finding: Qwen3-8B static LoRA failed its original whole first-line generation gate. Extra continuation is frequent. Posthoc three-digit-prefix scores do not qualify it.

teacher_training_contract: One fallback after the instruction_demo candidate fails. Copy the initial LoRA to teacher only, train on first 32 TRAIN rows per family shuffled together with seed 9111704, privileged instructions/examples and oracle whole-answer plus native EOS. Exactly 24 AdamW updates of 4 examples; frozen base and untouched initial learner. Save/freeze teacher and requalify once on 24 train plus 24 fallback_validation rows per family. No first-validation data in fallback training or qualification. Identical decoding, whole-answer EOS criteria, accuracy/gain/significance gates. No grid or further fallback.
